ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

SectionTitle.helper: Enter the section title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SectionCssClass.helper: Enter the section style name to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SectionTitleTag.helper: Choose the section title tag from the available options.

SectionIconClass.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

SectionAriaLabel.helper: Describe the section for downlevel browsers and handicapped visitors.

LinkList.helper: At least one link is required.

LinkText.helper: Enter the link text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

LinkUrl.helper: Can be a local or external web addresses.

LinkCssClass.helper: Enter the link style name to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

LinkRel.helper: Choose the link rel from the available options.

OpenInNewTab.helper: If checked, noopener & noreferrer will be added to the link for you.

ItemProp.helper: Choose what this link points to. If you are unsure, choose web addresses.
